name: wsib_tier3_current_predicate_pass_rate_pct
sql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE (w.trade_name_normalized IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(w.trade_name_normalized) >= 5 AND LENGTH(e.name_normalized) >= 5 AND similarity(w.trade_name_normalized, e.name_normalized) > 0.6 AND LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(w.trade_name_normalized, '^(THE|A|AN) ', ''), 1) = LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(e.name_normalized, '^(THE|A|AN) ', ''), 1)) OR (LENGTH(w.legal_name_normalized) >= 5 AND LENGTH(e.name_normalized) >= 5 AND similarity(w.legal_name_normalized, e.name_normalized) > 0.6 AND LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(w.legal_name_normalized, '^(THE|A|AN) ', ''), 1) = LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(e.name_normalized, '^(THE|A|AN) ', ''), 1))) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) FROM wsib_registry w JOIN entities e ON e.id = w.linked_entity_id WHERE w.match_confidence = 0.60

name: wsib_tier3_token_overlap_pass_pct
sql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(((SELECT array_agg(t) FROM unnest(regexp_split_to_array(regexp_replace(w.trade_name_normalized, '[-.''&+]', '', 'g'), '\s+')) t WHERE t <> ALL(ARRAY['CONSTRUCTION','CONTRACTING','BUILDERS','HOMES','GROUP','INC','LTD','LIMITED','CO','COMPANY','CORP','ENTERPRISES','DEVELOPMENTS','SERVICES','ONTARIO','CANADA','GENERAL','RENOVATION','RENOVATIONS','MANAGEMENT','DESIGN','BUILD','CUSTOM','HOME','IMPROVEMENT','IMPROVEMENTS','BUILDING','ASSOCIATES','TOP','ALL','QUALITY']::text[]) AND t !~ '^[0-9]+$') && (SELECT array_agg(t) FROM unnest(regexp_split_to_array(regexp_replace(e.name_normalized, '[-.''&+]', '', 'g'), '\s+')) t WHERE t <> ALL(ARRAY['CONSTRUCTION','CONTRACTING','BUILDERS','HOMES','GROUP','INC','LTD','LIMITED','CO','COMPANY','CORP','ENTERPRISES','DEVELOPMENTS','SERVICES','ONTARIO','CANADA','GENERAL','RENOVATION','RENOVATIONS','MANAGEMENT','DESIGN','BUILD','CUSTOM','HOME','IMPROVEMENT','IMPROVEMENTS','BUILDING','ASSOCIATES','TOP','ALL','QUALITY']::text[]) AND t !~ '^[0-9]+$')), false) OR COALESCE(((SELECT array_agg(t) FROM unnest(regexp_split_to_array(regexp_replace(w.legal_name_normalized, '[-.''&+]', '', 'g'), '\s+')) t WHERE t <> ALL(ARRAY['CONSTRUCTION','CONTRACTING','BUILDERS','HOMES','GROUP','INC','LTD','LIMITED','CO','COMPANY','CORP','ENTERPRISES','DEVELOPMENTS','SERVICES','ONTARIO','CANADA','GENERAL','RENOVATION','RENOVATIONS','MANAGEMENT','DESIGN','BUILD','CUSTOM','HOME','IMPROVEMENT','IMPROVEMENTS','BUILDING','ASSOCIATES','TOP','ALL','QUALITY']::text[]) AND t !~ '^[0-9]+$') && (SELECT array_agg(t) FROM unnest(regexp_split_to_array(regexp_replace(e.name_normalized, '[-.''&+]', '', 'g'), '\s+')) t WHERE t <> ALL(ARRAY['CONSTRUCTION','CONTRACTING','BUILDERS','HOMES','GROUP','INC','LTD','LIMITED','CO','COMPANY','CORP','ENTERPRISES','DEVELOPMENTS','SERVICES','ONTARIO','CANADA','GENERAL','RENOVATION','RENOVATIONS','MANAGEMENT','DESIGN','BUILD','CUSTOM','HOME','IMPROVEMENT','IMPROVEMENTS','BUILDING','ASSOCIATES','TOP','ALL','QUALITY']::text[]) AND t !~ '^[0-9]+$')), false)) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 2) FROM wsib_registry w JOIN entities e ON e.id = w.linked_entity_id WHERE w.match_confidence = 0.60

name: wsib_entity_fanin_max
sql: SELECT max(cnt)::int FROM (SELECT linked_entity_id, count(*) AS cnt FROM wsib_registry WHERE linked_entity_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY linked_entity_id) s

name: wsib_entity_fanin_p99
sql: SELECT round(percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cnt))::int FROM (SELECT linked_entity_id, count(*) AS cnt FROM wsib_registry WHERE linked_entity_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY linked_entity_id) s

name: wsib_magnet_entities_fanin_ge_10
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM (SELECT linked_entity_id FROM wsib_registry WHERE linked_entity_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY linked_entity_id HAVING count(*) >= 10) s

name: wsib_orphan_linked_entity_id
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM wsib_registry w WHERE w.linked_entity_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM entities e WHERE e.id = w.linked_entity_id)

name: wsib_linked_confidence_matched_at_inconsistent
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM wsib_registry WHERE (linked_entity_id IS NULL) != (match_confidence IS NULL) OR (linked_entity_id IS NULL) != (matched_at IS NULL)

name: wsib_confidence_outside_closed_set
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM wsib_registry WHERE match_confidence IS NOT NULL AND match_confidence NOT IN (0.95, 0.90, 0.60)

name: wsib_dead_bucket_050_060_count
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM wsib_registry WHERE match_confidence >= 0.50 AND match_confidence < 0.60

name: wsib_registered_entities_with_zero_links
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM entities e WHERE e.is_wsib_registered = true AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wsib_registry w WHERE w.linked_entity_id = e.id)

name: wsib_cumulative_link_rate_pct
sql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE linked_entity_id IS NOT NULL) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 2) FROM wsib_registry

name: entities_wsib_registered_count
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM entities WHERE is_wsib_registered = true

name: wsib_registered_entities_without_exact_tier_link
sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM entities e WHERE e.is_wsib_registered = true AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wsib_registry w WHERE w.linked_entity_id = e.id AND w.match_confidence IN (0.95, 0.90))

name: wsib_tier_confidence_split
sql: SELECT string_agg(match_confidence::text || ':' || cnt::text, ',' ORDER BY match_confidence) FROM (SELECT match_confidence, count(*) AS cnt FROM wsib_registry WHERE match_confidence IS NOT NULL GROUP BY match_confidence) s
